name: toolchain-run-non-executable-helper
title: run -- cannot execute the payload helpers the pack ships without the executable bit
description: The canonical helper-resolution form fails in the pack's own checkout: run ends in exec, and 30 of the 36 tracked scripts/ entries are mode 100644, including every .mjs and housekeeping.sh. The installer sets the bit, so the rule works from ~/.agents/bin and from a consumer and fails only where the bootstrap resolves the checkout copy.
creator: sdelmas
